GOD.notes: flat hand above the head, palm to midline, sweeps down toward the body

FATHER.notes: thumb of open 5-hand taps the forehead

MOTHER.notes: thumb of open 5-hand taps the chin

LORD.notes: L-hand from the dominant shoulder diagonally down to the opposite hip

JESUS.notes: middle finger of each open hand touches the opposite palm (nail marks)

WORSHIP.notes: hands clasped, drawn in toward the body with a slight bow

PRAISE.notes: applaud / present flat hands forward repeatedly

PRAY.notes: flat palms together, fingers up, in front of the chest

AMEN.notes: prayer hands pressed together, settle downward

HALLELUJAH.notes: raised open hands circling overhead in celebration

GRACE.notes: flat-O hand above the head opens and lowers (grace descending)

SALVATION.notes: crossed fists at the chest break free outward (freed / saved)

MERCY.notes: open hand circles over the heart

FAITH.notes: index at the forehead (think) then clasp — simplified to forehead contact

HOLY.notes: H-hand wipes across the open non-dominant palm (cleanses)

SPIRIT.notes: F-hands draw an essence upward from the chest

BLESS.notes: A-hands at the mouth open downward and forward (bestow blessing)

FORGIVE.notes: flat hand wipes across the open palm (wipe away)

I.notes: index points to / touches own chest

YOU.notes: index points forward at the addressee

WE.notes: index touches one side of the chest and arcs to the other

HE.notes: index points off to the side (third person)

THEY.notes: index points and sweeps across (plural third person)

MY.notes: flat hand on the chest, palm toward self

YOUR.notes: flat hand, palm forward toward the addressee

WHAT.notes: both open hands, palms up, slight shake

WHERE.notes: index up, shakes side to side

WHO.notes: thumb at chin, index bends near the mouth

WHY.notes: fingers touch the forehead then become a Y-hand

HOW.notes: bent hands roll up to palms-up

WHEN.notes: index circles the other index and lands on it

YES.notes: fist nods at the wrist like a head nodding yes

NO.notes: index and middle snap down to the thumb

NOT.notes: thumb under the chin flicks outward

NOW.notes: both Y-hands drop down slightly (present time)

TOMORROW.notes: thumb at the cheek arcs forward (future)

YESTERDAY.notes: thumb at the chin arcs back toward the ear (past)

WILL.notes: flat hand at the cheek moves forward (future tense)

HAVE.notes: fingertips of bent hands touch the chest

WANT.notes: claw hands palm-up pull in toward the body

KNOW.notes: fingertips of flat hand tap the forehead

SEE.notes: V-hand at the eyes moves forward

LOVE.notes: both fists crossed over the heart

COME.notes: index fingers beckon in toward the body

GO.notes: index fingers point and move away

SAY.notes: index circles forward from the mouth (speak)

THANK_YOU.notes: flat hand from the chin moves forward

GOOD.notes: flat hand from the chin moves down and forward

BAD.notes: flat hand from the chin flips palm-down and moves away

WORD.notes: G-hand measures a small length against the other index

HEAVEN.notes: flat hands sweep up and together overhead

HEART.notes: draw / tap a heart on the chest

LIFE.notes: L-hands move up the torso (life / live)

TRUE.notes: index from the mouth moves straight forward (truth)

AND.notes: open hand draws across and closes to a flat-O

HELLO.notes: flat-hand salute outward from the forehead

PLEASE.notes: flat hand circles on the chest

WELCOME.notes: open palm sweeps inward toward the body

HELP.notes: thumb-up fist on the open palm, lifted

SHE.notes: index points off to the side (third person)

OUR.notes: C/cupped hand arcs across the chest

MAN.notes: thumb of 5-hand from forehead down to chest

WOMAN.notes: thumb of 5-hand from chin down to chest

FAMILY.notes: F-hands circle around to meet (a group)

WORK.notes: dominant fist taps the back of the other wrist

LEARN.notes: lift information from the palm to the head

TEACH.notes: flat-O hands push knowledge outward from the head

UNDERSTAND.notes: index flicks up at the forehead

LOOK.notes: V-hand at the eyes moves out toward what is seen

FEEL.notes: middle finger strokes up the chest

SHOW.notes: index on the palm pushes it forward (present/show)

GIVE_THANKS.notes: both flat hands from the chin move outward (thanks)

STOP.notes: edge of one flat hand chops onto the other palm

LIKE.notes: middle finger and thumb draw out from the chest

SMALL.notes: flat hands move toward each other (small)

HAPPY.notes: flat hands brush up the chest repeatedly

NEW.notes: back of one hand scoops across the other palm

NIGHT.notes: bent hand rests over the other forearm (night)

DAY.notes: index arm arcs down across the body (day)

YEAR.notes: one fist circles around the other (a year)

BELIEVE.notes: index at the head, then hands clasp (think + marry)

SIN.notes: index fingers circle inward at the body

ANGEL.notes: fingertips at the shoulders flap like wings

CROSS.notes: C-hand traces a cross (down, then across)

KING.notes: K-hand from shoulder diagonally to the hip

GLORY.notes: shining hand lifts and shimmers off the palm

PEACE.notes: flat hands clasp and settle palms-down

JOY.notes: flat hands brush up the chest with joy

HOME.notes: flat-O touches near the mouth then the cheek

BOOK.notes: flat hands open like a book

WORLD.notes: W-hands circle around each other (the world)

CHURCH.notes: C-hand taps the back of the other fist

BECAUSE.notes: flat hand sweeps off the forehead into an A-thumb

TELL.notes: index at the chin rolls forward toward the listener

TALK.notes: 4-hand taps repeatedly in front of the mouth

ASK.notes: flat palms press together and draw in (request)

ANSWER.notes: two index hands flip forward-down from the mouth

BRING.notes: flat palms carry from one side to the other

TAKE.notes: open hand sweeps in and closes pulling toward the body

TRY.notes: both thumb-fists push forward against effort

DIE.notes: flat hands roll over from palm-up to palm-down

CALL.notes: H/U-hand taps the back of the other hand (summon/name)

CHOOSE.notes: F-hand picks and draws back toward the body

MOVE.notes: flat-O hands lift and shift to a new place

KEEP.notes: dominant V/K-hand rests crossed on the other (keep/maintain)

DRIVE.notes: both fists grip a wheel and push forward

PAY.notes: index flicks off the open palm toward the receiver

START.notes: index twists between the fingers of the open hand (begin)

MEET.notes: two upright index hands come together (two people meet)

MAKE.notes: stacked fists twist toward each other (make/create)

SING.notes: flat hand waves over the other forearm (song/music)

ANGRY.notes: claw hand drags up the chest (anger rising)

AFRAID.notes: open hands jump in front of the chest (fear)

TIRED.notes: bent hands at the chest droop downward (worn out)

SICK.notes: bent middle finger touches the forehead (ill)

RICH.notes: hand lifts a pile of money off the open palm

EASY.notes: fingers brush up the back of the other bent hand

CLEAN.notes: flat hand wipes clean across the other palm (clean/nice)

HOT.notes: claw at the mouth twists away (hot)

OLD.notes: C-hand strokes down from the chin (beard/old)

YOUNG.notes: bent hands brush up the chest (young/youthful)

TALL.notes: index slides up the other palm (height/tall)

LONG.notes: index draws up the length of the arm

FAST.notes: L-hands snap the thumbs in quickly (fast)

SLOW.notes: hand draws slowly up the back of the other hand

READY.notes: both R-hands shift to the side (ready)

RIGHT.notes: dominant index lands on the other (correct/right)

BEAUTIFUL.notes: open hand circles the face, closing to flat-O (beautiful)

WONDERFUL.notes: open hands push forward twice high up (wonderful)

WHITE.notes: open hand pulls off the chest closing to flat-O (white)

BROTHER.notes: male (forehead) then two L/1-hands come together

SISTER.notes: female (chin) then two L/1-hands come together

BABY.notes: cradled arms rock side to side (baby)

AFTERNOON.notes: flat hand angled down over the other arm (afternoon)

EVENING.notes: bent hand droops over the horizon arm (evening)

WEEK.notes: index slides forward across the palm (one week)

MONTH.notes: index slides down the upright other index (a month)

HOUR.notes: index circles once on the flat palm (an hour)

AGAIN.notes: bent hand arcs over and into the other palm (again)

SOON.notes: L/bent-L hand twists at the side (soon/later)

LATE.notes: flat hand swings back at the side (late/not yet)

FUTURE.notes: flat hand moves forward from the cheek (future)

PAST.notes: flat hand sweeps back over the shoulder (past/before)

CITY.notes: fingertips of both flat hands touch like rooftops (city/town)

COUNTRY.notes: hand circles on the other elbow (country)

HOUSE.notes: flat hands trace a roof then the walls (house)

HERE.notes: both palms circle flat in front (here/this place)

THERE.notes: index points off into the distance (there)

BREAD.notes: fingertips slice down the back of the other hand (bread)

COFFEE.notes: top fist grinds in a circle on the lower fist (coffee)

MEAT.notes: fingers pinch the web of the other hand (meat/flesh)

HEAD.notes: bent hand taps the temple then the jaw (head)

HAND.notes: flat hand slides off the back of the other hand (hand)

SUN.notes: C-hand draws the sun's circle up high

MOON.notes: bent-L frames the crescent at the brow (moon)

FIRE.notes: open hands flutter upward like flames (fire)

TREE.notes: upright forearm twists (tree), elbow on the other hand

ANIMAL.notes: bent hands at the chest rock in and out (animal)

CAT.notes: F-hand strokes whiskers off the cheek (cat)

BIRD.notes: G-hand opens and closes like a beak (bird)

SHEEP.notes: V-hand clips up the forearm like shearing wool (sheep)

LAMB.notes: same as SHEEP — clipping the wool (lamb)

MOUNTAIN.notes: fist taps the other then both rise into peaks (mountain)

SOUL.notes: F-hand draws the spirit up out of the other hand (soul/spirit)

PREACH.notes: F-hand thrusts forward from the temple (preach/sermon)

OBEY.notes: flat-O hands at the head open and bow forward (obey/submit)

HOPE.notes: bent hands bend toward each other (hope/expect)
